full_text_en:
Fotao Group Co., Ltd. Ceramics Research Institute v. Jinchang Ceramic Roller Rod Factory — dispute over infringement of non-patent technical secret

Plaintiff: Guangdong Fotao Group Co., Ltd. Ceramics Research Institute. Address: No. 18 Liuyuan Road, Shiwan, Foshan City, Guangdong Province.

Legal Representative: He Xiling, Director.

Agent ad litem: Wen Xu and Liu Mengbin, lawyers of Zhongshan Medical University Sanhuan Patent Agency, Guangdong Province.

Defendant: Guangdong Nanhai Jinchang Ceramic Roller Rod Factory. Address: Haizhou Baishajiang, Xiqiao Town, Nanhai City.

Legal Representative: Liang Chaofang, Chairman.

Agent ad litem: Ou Yongchao, Factory Director.

Agent ad litem: Lin Dewei, lawyer of Guangdong Yuegao Patent Agency.

The plaintiff, Guangdong Fotao Group Co., Ltd. Ceramics Research Institute (hereinafter referred to as Fotao Institute), filed a lawsuit with the Intermediate People's Court of Foshan, Guangdong Province, against the defendant, Guangdong Nanhai Jinchang Ceramic Roller Rod Factory (hereinafter referred to as Jinchang Factory), concerning a dispute over infringement of non-patent technical secret.

Plaintiff's Allegations: The production technology of "Fine Ceramic Roller Rod by Cold Isostatic Pressing" was a research project assigned to the institute by the Guangdong Provincial Science and Technology Commission in 1984. After several years of efforts, the institute successfully developed it. This technology was appraised by experts organized by the Guangdong Provincial Science and Technology Commission and the State Science and Technology Commission, and was classified as a state-classified technology, with a confidentiality period of 15 years starting from December 29, 1987. Although the institute later applied for patents for part of the technology, the contents not covered in the patent application documents and the patent technology before the patent application date still constitute technical secrets, which no one may infringe. At the beginning of 1992, the institute learned that the defendant Jinchang Factory was producing roller rods using the same mechanical equipment and substantially the same process flow as the institute, because the defendant used the technical secrets of the institute leaked by Ou Yongchao and Wu Guoxiong, who had previously worked at the institute. The plaintiff requested the court to order Jinchang Factory to immediately cease the infringement, compensate for economic losses, and make an apology.

Defendant's Defense: The production technology of "Fine Ceramic Roller Rod by Cold Isostatic Pressing" had been publicly disclosed by the author He Xiling in the fifth issue of "Ceramics" magazine published on October 15, 1990. The factory began its establishment at the end of 1991, invested a large amount of manpower, material resources, and financial resources, found this technical solution from a large amount of publicly available technical materials, and after digestion and exploration by the factory's technical personnel, finally mastered the technology. The technical source of the factory is legitimate and lawful, and there is no infringement. The plaintiff Fotao Institute, merely because the factory director was originally an employee of the institute, inferred that the factory's technology was obtained through infringement, but failed to provide evidence of what specific improper means the factory used to obtain its technical secrets. The grounds for the lawsuit are untenable.

The Intermediate People's Court of Foshan, Guangdong Province, after conducting a closed hearing, found the following facts:

In 1984, the Guangdong Provincial Science and Technology Commission assigned the production technology of "Fine Ceramic Roller Rod by Cold Isostatic Pressing" as a key research project to the Fotao Institute and allocated research funding of RMB 240,000. After accepting the research task, the Fotao Institute established a project team headed by He Xiling, and successively invested over RMB 13 million in the research, development, pilot testing, and improvement of production process equipment. After more than eight years of research and development, success was finally achieved. The "Fine Ceramic Roller Rod by Cold Isostatic Pressing" project was listed as a national Torch Program project after technical appraisal organized by the State Science and Technology Commission and the Guangdong Provincial Science and Technology Commission. The appraisal results concluded that its technical indicators and performance had reached the international advanced level and was a domestic initiative. From 1988 to 1993, it received 11 national, provincial, and municipal science and technology progress awards, technical achievement awards, high-tech awards, national new product awards, and gold medals at the Beijing International Invention Exhibition. After the product was launched on the market, it replaced imported roller rods, saved foreign exchange, and had a certain competitiveness in domestic and foreign markets. In 1994 alone, the annual output value of the Fotao Institute reached RMB 80 million, with profits and taxes of RMB 20 million. To protect this technological achievement, the Fotao Institute adopted various confidentiality measures, established a confidentiality leadership group, formulated confidentiality rules, and specified that the roller rod workshop, kiln equipment performance, raw material formulas, forming processes, and equipment drawings were all confidential. Anyone who intentionally or negligently disclosed or stole technical materials would be investigated for legal responsibility. On March 10, 1992, the Fotao Institute applied to the Guangdong Provincial Science and Technology Commission and the State Science and Technology Commission for state-classified technology. After experts organized by the Guangdong Provincial Science and Technology Commission and the State Science and Technology Commission conducted an appraisal through statutory procedures, the project was determined to be a state-classified technology on August 18, 1993, with a confidentiality period of 15 years starting from December 29, 1987. The scope of confidentiality included five major areas: (1) Formulas and raw material processing of ceramic roller rods (specific content omitted; similarly hereinafter); (2) Cold isostatic pressing equipment and production process technology; (3) Cold isostatic pressing forming and pre-forming processes and forming molds; (4) Firing technology for ceramic roller rods and suspended roof kilns; (5) Finishing equipment and processes for ceramic roller rods. On March 11, 1995, the State Science and Technology Commission again organized experts to conduct a technical evaluation and review of the Fotao Institute's "Fine Ceramic Roller Rod by Cold Isostatic Pressing" project. The technology was still confirmed as a state-classified technology, with the confidentiality period changed from the original 15 years to 8 years, starting from March 3, 1995, and continued to be subject to state-classified protection and management. On June 6, August 17, August 22, 1992, and April 28, 1993, the Fotao Institute respectively applied for four patents with the State Patent Office. The State Patent Office granted the Fotao Institute two utility model patents and one method invention patent on February 21, April 23, 1993, and June 1, 1994, with patent numbers 9233136.6, 92231110.2, 93104966.0, and 92104473.9 (pending approval number). On May 11, 1995, the State Patent Office confirmed that the contents of the above four patent applications had become publicly known patent technology from the date of application publication (patent technology content omitted). On May 10, 1995, the State Science and Technology Commission and the Guangdong Provincial Science and Technology Commission defined the patent technology and technical secrets of the Fotao Institute, holding that the technical secrets of the Fotao Institute that had been approved and filed totaled five major areas. Among them, the technical content of item 3 had become publicly known patent technology from the date of patent application publication, and the contents of the remaining four major items still constituted technical secrets that had not been declassified.

The defendant Jinchang Factory's director, Ou Yongchao, was originally a kiln technician at the Fotao Institute. He started working at the Fotao Institute in September 1982 doing kiln hanging work. At the end of 1989, he began to participate in the establishment of the Jinchang Factory, resigned voluntarily from the Fotao Institute in June 1990 to establish the Jinchang Factory, and was responsible for production technology. On March 7, 1992, the Jinchang Factory obtained its business license, officially started production in December of the same year, and in February 1993, its products began to enter the market for sale. Because the factory's technology was not up to standard and the product quality did not meet requirements, Ou Yongchao sought out Wu Guoxiong, who had previously worked at the Fotao Institute. Wu Guoxiong had worked at the Fotao Institute since June 1985, performing technical work in three processes including roller rod slip casting, isostatic pressing, tube forming, and roller rod batching. Ou Yongchao hired Wu Guoxiong with favorable treatment of RMB 70 per month and a year-end bonus of RMB 50,000. Wu Guoxiong left the Fotao Institute in February 1993 due to the expiration of his contract and went to the Jinchang Factory to be responsible for technical management. When purchasing machinery, molds, and raw materials, the Jinchang Factory ordered them from the same manufacturers that produced custom-made and manufactured items for the Fotao Institute. Relevant units in Yantai, Sichuan, Zhanjiang, Zhuhai, and other places all confirmed: when the Jinchang Factory purchased equipment, raw materials, and molds, it requested the manufacturers to produce them according to the technical quality requirements, specifications, sizes, and mechanical properties specified by the Fotao Institute. On May 2, 1995, the audit results of Guangdong Huayue Accounting Firm showed that from February 20, 1993 to August 1994, the Jinchang Factory sold a total of 35,443 roller rods, with sales revenue of RMB 4,479,796.53. The average profit per roller rod for the Fotao Institute was RMB 74.49.

An analysis and determination of the publicly known technical materials provided by the defendant Jinchang Factory, including US literature, the fifth issue of "Ceramics" magazine in 1990, and the four patent applications of the plaintiff Fotao Institute, revealed the following: (1) Regarding formulas and raw material processing, the patent applications disclosed only a range of formulas, but the optimal formula was not disclosed. The place of origin of raw materials, processing and mixing methods, and specific granulation processes different from traditional methods were not disclosed. Regarding the forming production process, the patents disclosed only the nozzle part of the extrusion and shaping machine, but the manufacturers, models, and specifications of the mixing and stirring machine, granulator, and extrusion and shaping machine were not disclosed. Regarding isostatic pressing equipment and pre-forming, the patents disclosed only one method for forming ceramic roller rods and the forming mold, but the manufacturers, places of origin, specifications, models, and technical parameters of the isostatic pressing equipment and inner and outer molds were not disclosed. The contents of the kiln, refractory materials, and firing methods were not disclosed. Regarding finishing equipment, the finishing methods and equipment after firing ceramic roller rods were not disclosed. In addition, the contents not covered in the patent specifications and application specifications of the four patent applications of the Fotao Institute still constituted technical secrets. (2) A comparison of the publicly known technology of "Fine Ceramic Roller Rod by Cold Isostatic Pressing," the technology of the Fotao Institute, and the production technology of the Jinchang Factory showed that the technology adopted by the Fotao Institute, in terms of ten key technologies including blank formula, granulation and forming methods, and main process equipment, was fundamentally different from the publicly known technology and was in a state of secrecy, while the technology used by the Jinchang Factory was identical to that of the Fotao Institute.

Further investigation found: The article published by He Xiling of the Fotao Institute in the fifth issue of "Ceramics" magazine in 1990 mainly involved the production process, forming process, main specifications, and technical performance of ceramic roller rods.

The above facts are confirmed by evidence including business licenses, original materials of the plaintiff's research, trial production, and inspection results, award certificates, patent technology content, technical secret content, appraisal certificates from the State Science and Technology Commission and the Guangdong Provincial Science and Technology Commission, manufacturer certificates, audit reports, photographs, and party statements.

The Intermediate People's Court of Foshan held that the plaintiff Fotao Institute's "Fine Ceramic Roller Rod by Cold Isostatic Pressing" project had practical value and competitive advantage and could bring significant economic benefits. The Fotao Institute adopted corresponding confidentiality measures, formulated confidentiality rules, and the State Science and Technology Commission confirmed it as state-classified technology. Therefore, the production technology of the Fotao Institute's "Fine Ceramic Roller Rod by Cold Isostatic Pressing" project should be regarded as a technical secret protected by law, and no unit or individual may illegally obtain, disclose, learn, or use it without the permission of the right holder. The defendant Jinchang Factory, knowing that the project was developed and owned by the Fotao Institute, hired Ou Yongchao and Wu Guoxiong, who had worked for many years at the Fotao Institute, with generous compensation, and without authorization used the cold isostatic pressing pre-forming process technology of the Fotao Institute. Both Ou Yongchao and Wu Guoxiong, whether during their employment at the Fotao Institute or after leaving, were obligated to maintain confidentiality regarding the Fotao Institute's technology. Without the consent of the Fotao Institute, Ou Yongchao and Wu Guoxiong disclosed the technical secrets and business information they had acquired during their tenure at the Fotao Institute to the Jinchang Factory, providing key technology for the infringing acts of the Jinchang Factory. The Jinchang Factory's defense that the technology it used was derived from "public magazines and relevant international literature, and was obtained through its own digestion and exploration" was examined. Although the basic principles and process terms of "Fine Ceramic Roller Rod by Cold Isostatic Pressing" production had been partially reported in public publications, such as the fifth issue of "Ceramics" in 1990, from a professional and technical perspective, they were only briefly mentioned or described as a rough scope, and the specific content of the Fotao Institute's technical secrets was not disclosed. The report in the fifth issue of "Ceramics" in 1990 was fundamentally different from the Fotao Institute's technical secrets. The above comparison proves that the Fotao Institute's technical secrets were not declassified due to the existence of publicly known technology. In ordinary scientific research, even if one finds the same literature and patent materials, to draw on and reference existing materials and obtain substantially the same technological achievements, repeated experimentation and exploration are necessary. Moreover, the "Fine Ceramic Roller Rod by Cold Isostatic Pressing" project was a high-difficulty, cutting-edge, and domestically original process technology, requiring even more arduous efforts. A large amount of original materials such as research records and trial production reports provided by the Fotao Institute confirmed that the technology was obtained by dozens of scientific and technical personnel of the Fotao Institute through unremitting efforts under good scientific research equipment conditions. In the litigation, since the Jinchang Factory raised the defense that the cold isostatic pressing pre-forming process technology it used was obtained by digesting and exploring publicly known technology, according to Article 64, Paragraph 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it should bear the burden of proof to confirm that its technology was obtained through the digestion and exploration of public materials, and after research and trial production, and therefore was lawfully and in good faith obtained. The Jinchang Factory only provided publicly known technical materials, but did not provide evidence regarding which known technologies it used for research and development, the specific ratios, and the specific time, place, and instruments of the research and development, and thus could not confirm the true source of its technology. The Jinchang Factory could not provide evidence for its claim and should bear the consequences of losing the lawsuit. Its defense that it did not infringe was not established and was not supported. The Jinchang Factory infringed upon the technical secrets of the Fotao Institute. According to Article 10 of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China, this constitutes an act of unfair competition. In accordance with Article 20 of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law and Article 118 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, the Jinchang Factory should immediately cease the infringement, compensate for losses, make an apology, and bear the litigation costs of this case. According to the audit report of Guangdong Huayue Accounting Firm, the amount of compensation should be determined by multiplying the number of roller rods sold by the Jinchang Factory by the average profit per roller rod of the Fotao Institute. The litigation claims of the Fotao Institute were lawful and reasonable and should be supported. Accordingly, the Intermediate People's Court of Foshan rendered the following judgment on July 13, 1995:

1. The defendant, Jinchang Ceramic Roller Rod Factory, shall immediately cease using the technical secret of "Fine Ceramic Roller Rod by Cold Isostatic Pressing" owned by the plaintiff, Guangdong Fotao Group Co., Ltd. Ceramics Research Institute, for the production and sale of ceramic roller rods upon the coming into effect of this judgment.

2. The Jinchang Ceramic Roller Rod Factory shall, within 10 days after the coming into effect of this judgment, compensate the Guangdong Fotao Group Co., Ltd. Ceramics Research Institute for economic losses in the amount of RMB 2,640,149. In case of delay, the amount shall be doubled at the same period commercial bank loan interest rate as a late payment penalty.

3. The Jinchang Ceramic Roller Rod Factory shall, within 10 days after the coming into effect of this judgment, publish a newspaper apology to the Guangdong Fotao Group Co., Ltd. Ceramics Research Institute (the content of the apology shall be subject to review by this court).

4. The Jinchang Ceramic Roller Rod Factory shall be obligated to maintain confidentiality regarding the technical secret of "Fine Ceramic Roller Rod by Cold Isostatic Pressing" of the Guangdong Fotao Group Co., Ltd. Ceramics Research Institute and shall not expand the scope of knowledge without authorization.

The case acceptance fee is RMB 20,010, and the property preservation fee is RMB 10,520, totaling RMB 30,530, to be borne by the defendant, Jinchang Ceramic Roller Rod Factory.

After the first instance judgment was pronounced, the parties did not file an appeal within the statutory period.
